summary: FiEE, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $6,272,809 of common stock through sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. Shares will be sold on Nasdaq at prevailing market prices; A.G.P. receives 3.25% commission. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
